info.name: Mekari Klikpajak - CoreTax (CTAS) Single Tax Invoice
info.description: Pre-configured Postman Collection with automated HMAC-SHA256 pre-request script and X-Idempotency-Key support for creating Normal and Pengganti (Replacement with -1, -2 suffix) Single Tax Invoices in Mekari Klikpajak CoreTax.

exec: // 1. Calculate SHA-256 Digest of Request Body
var header = 'hmac username="' + username + '", algorithm="hmac-sha256", headers="date request-line", signature="' + signature + '"';
// If the request already specifies a custom key (e.g. INVQBL0001-1 for Pengganti), preserve it.
// Otherwise, generate a fresh UUID v4.
// Set headers directly on the request
